name: Eternal Life Hospice
description: Medicare-certified, ACHC-accredited hospice care serving Ventura and Los Angeles counties. Same-day admissions, 24/7 nursing, whole-person comfort care.

surfaces.name: care-guide
surfaces.description: Interactive decision guide helping families, patients, or providers identify their next step with hospice care.

surfaces.name: schedule-connect
surfaces.description: Schedule a time to speak with Aleksandra Dubina, Founder and CEO of Eternal Life Hospice.

surfaces.name: contact-elh
surfaces.description: Contact Eternal Life Hospice: general inquiries, hospice questions, or request a callback from a family or patient.

surfaces.name: submit-physician-referral
surfaces.description: Submit a patient referral to Eternal Life Hospice. For referring physicians documenting a terminal prognosis and initiating the hospice election process.

surfaces.name: submit-discharge-referral
surfaces.description: Submit a patient referral to Eternal Life Hospice. For hospital discharge planners coordinating a safe, same-day or next-day transition to hospice.

surfaces.name: connect-as-coordinator
surfaces.description: Connect with Eternal Life Hospice as a case manager, skilled nursing facility, or assisted living coordinator to initiate or discuss a patient referral.

surfaces.name: share-voice-brief
surfaces.description: Submit interest in contributing to the Eternal Care Brief or scheduling an educational session.

surfaces.name: submit-referral
surfaces.description: Submit a patient referral to Eternal Life Hospice. For healthcare professionals referring a patient for hospice evaluation.
